questions.stem: Why are most leaves broad and thin?

options.text: To reduce the amount of water the plant needs
To maximise the surface area for light absorption and reduce the distance for gas diffusion
To make the plant taller and more competitive
To store more starch for energy

questions.explanation: A broad, thin shape gives a large surface area to capture maximum light, while the short diffusion distance allows gases to reach photosynthesising cells quickly.
